Herbalist Lee Hyeong-seol (No. 010-7123-2294)

Today, I climbed a high mountain with my younger brother Jeong-man to gather wild herbs.

Downstairs, watercress was in full bloom, and the stream in the mountain valley was flowing down vigorously.

As we climbed the mountain, the large primrose and water lily, which grow naturally in high mountains, were in bloom.

By the small stream, the cress was in full bloom, and I saw bat-weed growing as well.

Right next to the Korean angelica, the maple leaf aster was forming a colony, and here, let's take a look at some high-altitude wild herbs and poisonous plants.

Here, the pheasant's-eye fern is forming a colony.

The pheasant's-eye fern is called the hairy fern because it has a lot of hair, and it is a delicious herb.

And I see a lot of bear's-eye fern as well.

Right next to the bear's-eye fern, the poisonous *Donguinamul*, which has similar leaf shapes, was in bloom, and the *Eosuri* had grown quite a bit.

As I moved a little further, I started to see *Songi-pul* (a type of edible plant), and I also spotted young shoots of *Haneulmal-nari* (a type of lily) and *Ogaphi* (Eleutherococcus senticosus).

Although *Haneulmal-nari* is edible as a vegetable, its similar poisonous plant, *Satgat-namul* (a type of edible plant), has begun to bloom, and another poisonous plant, *Paksae* (a type of edible plant), is growing so vigorously that it will soon dominate the entire forest.

Herbalist Lee Hyung-seol (010-7123-2294)

Today, I went up a high mountain with Director Seo and my younger brother Jeong-man to pick angelica sprouts.

After the rain, the leaves in the mountains had grown quite a bit, decorating the May forest even more beautifully.

en-US.title: How to distinguish between wild herbs picked before Aralia elata appears and poisonous plants.
en-US.description:
#Aralia #Eosuri #Allium

Herbalist Lee Hyeong-seol (No. 010-7123-2294)

Today, I went to the valley to gather wild greens.

Although the cherry blossoms haven't bloomed in Jeongseon yet, new shoots have started sprouting on the leaves along the valley, and azaleas are just beginning to bloom in sunny spots.

After the rain for the past few days, the water level in the valley has risen significantly, and the lush green grasses sprouting up seem to be adorning the season of spring even more beautifully.

Here, the Anemone has bloomed, and the Corydalis has also bloomed beautifully; right next to it, the new shoots of the poisonous Aconitum are coming up in abundance.

I also see the new shoots of another poisonous plant, the Bloodroot, and the Mountain Corydalis in bloom.

Along the edge of the valley, Angelica is growing abundantly, and in the midst of it, there is also the Dwarf Rum, a wild green whose leaves grow large starting from its new shoots.

I decided to pick *Jeonho* here. It is a wild vegetable with a pleasant taste and aroma; it can be eaten raw or lightly blanched and seasoned.

Mountain water parsley and *Padeudeuk* (a type of wild vegetable) are starting to appear in small quantities along the stream. Like *Jeonho*, these vegetables can also be eaten raw or lightly blanched and seasoned.

Look, there is some *Myeongi* (wild garlic) with lush leaves here.

I have only ever seen cultivated *Myeongi*, so this is the first time I am seeing it growing in the wild like this.

I see new shoots of the *Prunus padus* sprouting along the stream.

The new shoots of the *Prunus padus* are also eaten as a vegetable, but they are a polarizing choice due to their unique aroma.

Although it is spring and flowers are blooming, there are still places in the shade where the ice hasn't melted yet.

I discover *Pulsatilla koreana* in bloom here.

Until a few years ago, I traveled all the way to the southern coast to photograph *Pulsatilla koreana*, so it is a pity that I failed to spot them when they were right here.

There are quite a lot of *Seodeolchwi* growing here. At this time of year, it is still too early for other wild herbs, so only *Jeonho* and *Seodeolchwi* can be harvested.

Here, we take a look at some edible plants that people often overlook.

There is *Beolkkaedeonggul*.

These are the young shoots of *Danggaejichi* and *Gwangdaesuyeom*.

Finally, we examine *Jiojumpul*.

We have dinner made with the wild herbs gathered today, including seasoned salads, wraps, and wild herb and seafood pancakes.

This is the story of herbs and health, along with hiking information, from Lee Hyeong-seol, a medicinal herb gatherer in the mountains of Jeongseon, Gangwon-do.

Herbalist Lee Hyung-seol (010-7123-2294)

Today, I have prepared a video on how to make pickled Myeongi.

First, you need to clean the harvested Myeongi thoroughly and remove the moisture. In the meantime, prepare the soy sauce decoction.

snippet.title: 땅두릅이 지천이다! 한 소쿠리 금방 가득.
snippet.description:
#땅두릅 #두릅 #봄나물
약초꾼 이형설 (010~7123~2294번)
남쪽 지방은 벚꽃이 만개했다고 하는 정선 산골에는 이제 진달래와 생강나무가 꽃 피우기 시작했습니다.
오늘은 자그마한 계곡가 햇빛이 잘 드는 곳으로 김 사장 내외분과 땅두릅을 채취하러 갔었지요.
4월이 되면 봄나물 중 가장 호사스러운 나물은 두릅나물이 아닌가 생각합니다.
봄에 나는 두릅은 금(金)이라 불릴 만큼 흙을 걷어 내고 칼로 잘라 채취하는 땅두릅은 나물의 제왕이라는 명예를 가진 만큼 독특한 향과 맛이 좋답니다.
땅두릅 뿌리는 한방에서 독활이라고 합니다.
독활(獨活)은 몸속의 유해 물질 배출을 촉진하여 항산화작용 즉 산화를 억제하는 작용을 합니다.
물이나 공기 중 산소에 의한 식품의 산화에는 특히 불포화지방산을 함유하는 산화와 변질, 열화가 문제가 되는 원인을 예방하고 치료해주어 간질환에 효과적이다 할 수 있겠습니다.
독활의 칼륨 성분은 식염 즉 염화나트륨인 소금의 과다 섭취로 인한 질환과 피해를 막아주고 간을 보호하는데 효과적입니다.

Herbalist Lee Hyung-seol (010-7123-2294)

올봄은 눈이 자주 내려 눈 속에서 채취한 자작나무 수액을 운반하는데 힘이 더 드는 것 같군요
자작나무는 낙엽활엽수로 혹한에서 자라고 추위에 강하며 수피는 백색으로 봄철 채취하는 나무 수액 중 가장 으뜸인 것이 자작나무 수액으로 효능이 매우 뛰어나 황제 수액이라 불린답니다

en-US.description:
#BirchSap #BirchSap #SapGoodForCancer

Today, I am climbing a high mountain in Gangwon-do to collect birch sap.

Birch sap begins to flow after the maple sap season ends, and since the trees grow naturally in high-altitude mountains, there is a slight time difference in the sap collection process.

With frequent snowfall this spring, it seems more strenuous to transport the birch sap collected from the snow.

Birch trees are deciduous broad-leaved trees that grow in harsh winters and are resistant to cold. Their bark is white, and birch sap is considered the best among tree saps collected in the spring; due to its exceptional efficacy, it is called "Emperor Sap."

Birch sap from the high mountains of Gangwon-do is collected from late March to early April. This is the time when birch trees, having awakened from their winter slumber, draw up sap filled with spring energy. The sap collected at this time is known to be rich in nutrients and highly effective.

Birch sap, known as "Emperor Sap," has blood-purifying and detoxifying effects, boosting immunity, providing antioxidant benefits, and preventing aging. It is said to have anti-inflammatory effects and benefits for cognitive function.

Birch sap contains various nutrients, including magnesium, manganese, sugars, saponins, potassium, and Vitamin C, as well as amino acids, folic acid, and polyphenols.

Rich in nutrients beneficial to the body, birch sap offers excellent anti-aging and whitening effects for the skin. Its superior alcohol-breaking ability helps alleviate hangovers and improve liver function.

Furthermore, because it aids in the elimination of waste from blood vessels, it is beneficial for preventing high blood pressure and various adult diseases such as diabetes and arteriosclerosis. It also helps with weight loss by facilitating fluid balance within the body.

In addition, it is known to be effective against various types of cancer as it inhibits the proliferation of cancer cells and delays tumor growth.

Birch sap is collected drop by drop in plastic bags, placed in containers, and transported.

We collect the birch sap, package it in PET bottles like this, and sell it. We will send you 12 bottles of 1.5 liters for 60,000 won and 6 bottles of 1.5 liters for 35,000 won.

en-US.title: The first wild greens to appear in the high mountains of Gangwon-do!
en-US.description:
#Cardamine #WildGreens #SpringGreens

Herbalist Lee Hyung-seol (010-7123-2294)

Yesterday, being the weekend, I went on a hike to a high mountain to find Cardamine.

Cardamine is a plant that grows along valleys and is one of the first wild greens available for consumption in early spring. In sunny spots, ginger trees are bursting into bloom, and violets have also appeared.

Ice still remains on this mountain, and melted ice water is flowing down vigorously.

There is quite a bit of Cardamine along the valley.

Cardamine has a spicy and pungent taste similar to mustard, so it is called the "mustard greens of the mountains." It stimulates a lost appetite in the spring and pairs well with raw fish and pork belly.

Cardamine promotes smooth gastrointestinal movement, which is beneficial for improving appetite. It also contains a large amount of carotenoids, an antioxidant, which helps prevent aging and has anticancer properties. In addition, it is rich in vitamins A and C and minerals, which strengthen the immune system to prevent colds and various diseases, and it is effective in preventing cardiovascular diseases by lowering cholesterol levels.

After finishing the hike for *Neungjaengi-naengi*, I prepared raw and steamed abalone sent by subscriber Han Jong-hak from Busan, and am having dinner accompanied by *Neungjaengi-naengi*.

This is the story of herbs and health, as well as hiking information, from Lee Hyung-seol, a medicinal herb gatherer in the mountains of Jeongseon, Gangwon-do.

snippet.description:
#자작나무수액 #자작나무 #황제수액
약초꾼 이형설 (010~7123~2294번)
3월 하순으로 접어들자 강원도 정선 산골에도 기온이 많이 올라 한낮엔 따사로움을 맘껏 느낄 수 있습니다.
오늘은 서감독과 정만이 아우와 자작나무 수액을 받으러 높은 산을 올랐었지요.
자작나무 수액은 고로쇠 수액이 끝난 후 3월 하순에서 4월 초에 채취할 수 있으며 오늘은 자작나무 수액 판매 영상 준비하였습니다.
자작나무 수액은 1,5리터 6병에 35,000원, 12병에 6만원에 판매하오니 구입을 원하시는 분께서는 아래 자막을 참고하시어 연락 주시면 감사하겠습니다.
여기에서 자작나무와 수액에 대해 잠시 알아보도록 합니다.
자작나무는 낙엽활엽수로 혹한에서 자라며 추위에 강하며 수피는 백색으로 봄철 채취하는 나무 수액 중 가장 으뜸인 것이 자작나무 수액으로 황제 수액이라 불린답니다. 겨울잠에서 깨어난 자작나무가 봄의 에너지를 가득 담은 수액은 영양분이 풍부하고 효능이 뛰어나다고 알려져 있답니다.
황제 수액이라 불리는 자작나무 수액은 청열(淸熱), 해독(解毒) 작용이 있어 면역력 증진 및 항산화 작용, 노화 방지, 항염증 효과와 뇌인지 기능 개선에 효과가 있다고 합니다.
그리고 자작나무 수액은 마그네슘, 망간, 당분, 베툴린, 사포닌, 칼륨, 비타민C, 아미노산, 엽산, 폴리페놀 등 다양한 영양소가 함유되어 있습니다.
이 성분들은 피부 노화 및 미백 효과에 뛰어나며 알코올 분해 능력이 탁월하여 숙취 및 간 기능 개선에 도움을 준다고 합니다.
또한 혈관 내 노폐물 배출을 도와주기 때문에 고혈압 예방과 당뇨병, 동맥경화 등 각종 성인병 예방에 좋으며 체내 수분 공급을 원활하게 하여 붓기 다이어트에 도움이 됩니다.

#자작나무수액 #자작나무 #황제수액
약초꾼 이형설 (010~7123~2294번)
3월 하순으로 접어들자 강원도 정선 산골에도 기온이 많이 올라 한낮엔 따사로움을 맘껏 느낄 수 있습니다.
오늘은 서감독과 정만이 아우와 자작나무 수액을 받으러 높은 산을 올랐었지요.
자작나무 수액은 고로쇠 수액이 끝난 후 3월 하순에서 4월 초에 채취할 수 있으며 오늘은 자작나무 수액 판매 영상 준비하였습니다.
자작나무 수액은 1,5리터 6병에 35,000원, 12병에 6만원에 판매하오니 구입을 원하시는 분께서는 아래 자막을 참고하시어 연락 주시면 감사하겠습니다.
여기에서 자작나무와 수액에 대해 잠시 알아보도록 합니다.
자작나무는 낙엽활엽수로 혹한에서 자라며 추위에 강하며 수피는 백색으로 봄철 채취하는 나무 수액 중 가장 으뜸인 것이 자작나무 수액으로 황제 수액이라 불린답니다. 겨울잠에서 깨어난 자작나무가 봄의 에너지를 가득 담은 수액은 영양분이 풍부하고 효능이 뛰어나다고 알려져 있답니다.
황제 수액이라 불리는 자작나무 수액은 청열(淸熱), 해독(解毒) 작용이 있어 면역력 증진 및 항산화 작용, 노화 방지, 항염증 효과와 뇌인지 기능 개선에 효과가 있다고 합니다.
그리고 자작나무 수액은 마그네슘, 망간, 당분, 베툴린, 사포닌, 칼륨, 비타민C, 아미노산, 엽산, 폴리페놀 등 다양한 영양소가 함유되어 있습니다.
이 성분들은 피부 노화 및 미백 효과에 뛰어나며 알코올 분해 능력이 탁월하여 숙취 및 간 기능 개선에 도움을 준다고 합니다.
또한 혈관 내 노폐물 배출을 도와주기 때문에 고혈압 예방과 당뇨병, 동맥경화 등 각종 성인병 예방에 좋으며 체내 수분 공급을 원활하게 하여 붓기 다이어트에 도움이 됩니다.
그리고 항암효과가 뛰어난데 암세포 증식을 억제할 뿐 아니라 종양 성장을 지연시키므로 각종 암에 좋다고 합니다.

en-US.description:
#BirchSap #BirchTree #EmperorSap

Herbalist Lee Hyung-seol (010-7123-2294)

As we enter late March, temperatures have risen significantly even in the mountain valleys of Jeongseon, Gangwon-do, allowing us to fully enjoy the warmth during the day.

Today, I climbed a high mountain with Director Seo and my younger brother Jeong-man to collect birch sap.

Birch sap can be harvested from late March to early April after the maple sap season ends. Today, I have prepared a video for birch sap sales.

Birch sap is sold for 35,000 won for 6 bottles of 1.5 liters or 60,000 won for 12 bottles. If you wish to purchase, please refer to the subtitles below and contact me.

Let's take a brief look at birch trees and sap here. Birch trees are deciduous broad-leaved trees that grow in harsh winters and are resistant to cold. Their bark is white, and birch sap is considered the finest among tree saps harvested in the spring, earning it the nickname "Emperor Sap." It is known that this sap, which is filled with the energy of spring after the birch tree awakens from its winter slumber, is rich in nutrients and possesses outstanding efficacy.

Birch sap, known as "Emperor Sap," is said to have heat-clearing and detoxifying properties, and is effective in boosting immunity, providing antioxidant benefits, preventing aging, reducing inflammation, and improving cognitive function.

Furthermore, birch sap contains various nutrients such as magnesium, manganese, sugars, betulin, saponins, potassium, vitamin C, amino acids, folic acid, and polyphenols.

These components are excellent for preventing skin aging and whitening, and due to their superior alcohol-decomposing ability, they are said to help alleviate hangovers and improve liver function. Furthermore, because it helps eliminate waste products from blood vessels, it is beneficial for preventing high blood pressure and various adult diseases such as diabetes and arteriosclerosis. It also aids in reducing swelling by facilitating the body's hydration.

In addition, it has excellent anticancer effects; it is said to be effective against various types of cancer as it not only inhibits the proliferation of cancer cells but also delays tumor growth.

This is the story of herbs and health, along with hiking information, from Lee Hyung-seol, a medicinal herb gatherer in the mountains of Jeongseon, Gangwon-do.
